description: Scaffold an agent-friendly Rust command-line tool at the repository root — a Cargo workspace (`Cargo.toml` with the tool package, version `0.1.0-dev`, edition 2024, `rust-version` = the MSRV computed from the dependency graph, an explicit `[[bin]]`, `[workspace.lints]` with `missing_docs`, `unsafe_code = "forbid"`, Clippy `pedantic` plus `print_stdout`/`print_stderr`/`dbg_macro`, and a release profile with fat LTO, `codegen-units = 1`, stripped symbols and `panic = "unwind"` kept on purpose; `Cargo.lock` committed), `rust-toolchain.toml` (stable + rustfmt, clippy, llvm-tools), `rustfmt.toml`, `deny.toml` (cargo-deny advisories/licenses/bans/sources), `.cargo/config.toml` (the `cargo xtask` alias), a thin `src/main.rs` and a library holding all logic — clap 4 derive tree with the global flags `--format text|json|jsonl`/`--json`/`--no-color`/`--no-input`/`-q`/`-v`/`--log-format`/`--config` (`<BIN>_FORMAT`/`<BIN>_NO_INPUT`/`<BIN>_CONFIG` through clap's `env`), the exit-code enum 0–7/130/143 in one file, a `thiserror` error with the JSON error envelope on stderr, sorted-key compact JSON and a `jsonl` summary line, colour per stream (TTY, `NO_COLOR`, `TERM=dumb`, `FORCE_COLOR`, `--no-color`, machine mode), prompts only on a terminal and never under `--no-input`/`<BIN>_NO_INPUT`/`CI`, flags → env → TOML config file → defaults, SIGINT/SIGTERM → 130/143 (immediate when nothing needs cleanup, deferred with a guard otherwise), broken pipe as a quiet exit 0, a panic as exit 1 — and the commands `greet [NAME] [--ask]`, `completion <shell>`, `schema [COMMAND]` (clap's `Command` walked into JSON with per-command exit codes and safety metadata), `version` and `--version`; with `ui: tui` a Ratatui `browse` picker (TTY-gated → exit 2 with a pointer to `greet --json`, terminal restored on panic and on SIGTERM, state and drawing unit-tested with `TestBackend`, the list rendering only the rows that fit, and — per the catalog's UI contract — a `.ui-quality.yml` at the repository root, a test-only `src/tui/ui_screenshots.rs` helper and UI tests capturing every picker state in each direction as `.ui-screenshots/screen/App/<state>--<direction>--no-color.txt` with the asserted accessibility checks). Tests: in-process tests of `run` with injected terminal facts and environment, assert_cmd + predicates + snapbox golden-file end-to-end tests of the real binary, ~98% line coverage measured with cargo-llvm-cov (80% bar). An `xtask` member generates man pages (clap_mangen), completions (clap_complete) and `docs/modules/ROOT/pages/cli-reference.adoc` (only when the Antora module exists; `--check` for CI). Invoke as `/iru-setup-rust-cli`. Accepts pre-resolved inputs via `args` (`key: value` lines) — `bin-name`, `crate-name`, `description`, `ui` (`none`/`tui`), `msrv`, `branching` (`gitflow`/`main-only`), `license`, `developer-name`, `developer-email`, `organization-url`, `owner`, `repository-url`, `accessibility` (`enforce`/`report`/`off`/`none`, `ui: tui` only), `open-source`, `visibility`, `ci`, `sonar` (+ `sonar-organization`/`sonar-project-key`/ `sonar-host-url`), `distribution` (`none`/`internal`/`store`), `mode` (`new`/`existing`) and `on-existing` (`ask`/`keep`/`update`/`replace`) — so `iru-setup-cli-repository` can drive it without re-prompting. Announces whether it is scaffolding from scratch or updating; for every file group it owns that already exists it warns and asks Update / Keep as is / Replace / Stop (unless `on-existing` decides), never overwrites hand-written source, and treats a foreign Cargo layout as foreign. Every crate version is looked up live on crates.io with a verified 2026-10-16 fallback table. Ends by running the contract's gates (fmt, clippy `-D warnings`, nextest, doctests, rustdoc `-D warnings`, cargo-deny, cargo-llvm-cov, `cargo xtask docs`, an MSRV check) and smoke checks of the release binary on pipes and on a pseudo-terminal.
